boundary: Ten serial repeats maximum,first failure stops. Parent watchdog and gateway observers can change timing. Not six-way capacity, historical EAGAIN causal proof, new source/seed, speedup or quality.

gpu.boundary: Assigned device, sampled whole-GPU utilization during the candidate execute call, not per-process kernel time; errors/missing values are not zero.

stacks.boundary: Parent-kernel thread stacks only;30s nominal watchdog interval, actual emission times unavailable. A single waiting stack does not prove deadlock. No local variables or source lines.
